up: For the target 'Metabotropic glutamate receptor 5' (CHEMBL ID: CHEMBL3227) in Homo sapiens, return the IC50 activity values in nM. For each activity, list the molecule's ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, compound key, and publication provenance as PubMed ID or DOI (prefer PubMed ID if both exist), along with the assay description, activity standard type, relation, value, units, activity comment, target name, and target organism. Exclude any rows where the SMILES is missing or where neither a PubMed ID nor a DOI is available.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  cr.compound_key,
  COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
  ass.description AS assay_description,
  act.standard_type,
  act.relation,
  act.value,
  act.units,
  act.activity_comment,
  td.pref_name AS target_name,
  td.organism
FROM activities act
JOIN assays ass ON act.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON act.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_records cr ON act.record_id = cr.record_id
JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3227'
  AND act.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND act.units = 'nM'
  AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL
  AND (d.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR d.doi IS NOT NULL);
